rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: The Prime Minister's statement dated 21 September 2005, under the breadcrumb 小泉総理の演説・記者会見等, says that, following the general election, he had that day for the third time taken on the heavy responsibility of Prime Minister (本日、三度、内閣総理大臣の重責を担うこととなりました).
